queries.item: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:referers` ( `referer_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `ip` varchar(20) NOT NULL, `referer_url` varchar(500) NOT NULL, `server_url` varchar(500) NOT NULL, `time` int(11) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`referer_id`), UNIQUE KEY `ip` (`ip`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:referer_sessions` ( `referer_session_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `referer_id` int(11) NOT NULL, `referer_url` varchar(500) NOT NULL, `server_url` varchar(500) NOT NULL, `time` int(11) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`referer_session_id`), KEY `referer_id` (`referer_id`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB;
